title: DMW: Filipinos in Riyadh safe after missile attacks

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No Filipino was harmed following the missile attacks on Riyadh, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said on Monday morning. Yemeni militant group the Houthis, Iran’s crucial ally on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula, launched drone and ballistic missile attacks on the Saudi Arabia capital over the weekend.
